Mivel 1+2+⋯+n=n(n+1)/21+2+\dots+n=n(n+1)/21+2+⋯+n=n(n+1)/2, 1+2+⋯+nn+2−n2=n(n+1)−n(n+2)2(n+2)=−n2n+4⟶−12.\begin{aligned} \frac{1+2+\dots+n}{n+2}-\frac n2 &=\frac{n(n+1)-n(n+2)}{2(n+2)} =-\frac{n}{2n+4} \longrightarrow\boxed{-\frac12} \text. \end{aligned}n+21+2+⋯+n​−2n​​=2(n+2)n(n+1)−n(n+2)​=−2n+4n​⟶−21​​.​

Ezért n3+3n2+n4+135n6+24+n7+3n35⟶154.\frac{\sqrt{n^3+3n^2}+\sqrt[3]{n^4+1}} {\sqrt[4]{5n^6+2}+\sqrt[5]{n^7+3n^3}} \longrightarrow\frac{1}{\sqrt[4]{5}} \text.45n6+2​+5n7+3n3​n3+3n2​+3n4+1​​⟶45​1​. A második tagra 0≤n!(n+1)!+32n≤n!(n+1)!=1n+1⟶0,0\leq\frac{n!}{(n+1)!+3^{2n}} \leq\frac{n!}{(n+1)!}=\frac{1}{n+1}\longrightarrow0 \text,0≤(n+1)!+32nn!​≤(n+1)!n!​=n+11​⟶0, így a teljes határérték 154.\boxed{\frac{1}{\sqrt[4]{5}}} \text.45​1​​.

  6. Legyen un=n2−n33u_n=\sqrt[3]{n^2-n^3}un​=3n2−n3​. A köbök összegének azonosságával un+n=un3+n3un2−nun+n2=n2un2−nun+n2.u_n+n =\frac{u_n^3+n^3}{u_n^2-nu_n+n^2} =\frac{n^2}{u_n^2-nu_n+n^2} \text.un​+n=un2​−nun​+n2un3​+n3​=un2​−nun​+n2n2​. Mivel un=−n(1−1/n)1/3u_n=-n(1-1/n)^{1/3}un​=−n(1−1/n)1/3, ezért un+n=1(1−1/n)2/3+(1−1/n)1/3+1⟶13.u_n+n =\frac{1} {(1-1/n)^{2/3}+(1-1/n)^{1/3}+1} \longrightarrow\boxed{\frac13} \text.un​+n=(1−1/n)2/3+(1−1/n)1/3+11​⟶31​​.

question:
Határozza meg az alábbi határértékeket!

  1. lim⁡n→∞5n2−30n−21n\displaystyle \lim_{n \rightarrow \infty} \sqrt[n]{5n^2 - 30n - 21}n→∞lim​n5n2−30n−21​

  2. lim⁡n→∞(cos⁡n32n−3n6n+1)\displaystyle \lim_{n \rightarrow \infty} \left( \frac{\cos n^3}{2n} - \frac{3n}{6n+1} \right)n→∞lim​(2ncosn3​−6n+13n​)

  5. lim⁡n→∞(1+1n)ln⁡n\displaystyle \lim_{n \rightarrow \infty} \left( 1 + \frac{1}{n} \right)^{\ln n}n→∞lim​(1+n1​)lnn

  6. lim⁡n→∞(n2−n+1n2+n+1)2n+5\displaystyle \lim_{n \rightarrow \infty} \left( \frac{n^2 - n + 1}{n^2 + n + 1} \right)^{2n + 5}n→∞lim​(n2+n+1n2−n+1​)2n+5
solution:
További határértékek

  1. 5n2−30n−21n=n2/n(5−30n−21n2)1/n⟶1.\begin{aligned} \sqrt[n]{5n^2-30n-21} &=n^{2/n}\left(5-\frac{30}{n}-\frac{21}{n^2}\right)^{1/n} \longrightarrow\boxed{1} \text. \end{aligned}n5n2−30n−21​​=n2/n(5−n30​−n221​)1/n⟶1​.​

  2. Mivel ∣cos⁡n3∣≤1|\cos n^3|\leq1∣cosn3∣≤1, cos⁡n32n⟶0,3n6n+1⟶12,\frac{\cos n^3}{2n}\longrightarrow0, \qquad \frac{3n}{6n+1}\longrightarrow\frac12 \text,2ncosn3​⟶0,6n+13n​⟶21​, tehát lim⁡n→∞(cos⁡n32n−3n6n+1)=−12.\boxed{ \lim_{n\to\infty}\left( \frac{\cos n^3}{2n}-\frac{3n}{6n+1} \right)=-\frac12 } \text.n→∞lim​(2ncosn3​−6n+13n​)=−21​​.

  3. Logaritmust véve nln⁡(1+1n2)∼1n⟶0,n\ln\left(1+\frac{1}{n^2}\right) \sim\frac1n\longrightarrow0,nln(1+n21​)∼n1​⟶0, ezért (1+1n2)n⟶1.\boxed{\left(1+\frac{1}{n^2}\right)^n\longrightarrow1} \text.(1+n21​)n⟶1​.

  4. (3n−13n+2)2n=(1−33n+2)2n⟶elim⁡n→∞−6n/(3n+2)=e−2.\left(\frac{3n-1}{3n+2}\right)^{2n} =\left(1-\frac{3}{3n+2}\right)^{2n} \longrightarrow e^{\lim\limits_{n\to\infty}-6n/(3n+2)} =\boxed{e^{-2}} \text.(3n+23n−1​)2n=(1−3n+23​)2n⟶en→∞lim​−6n/(3n+2)=e−2​.

  5. ln⁡((1+1n)ln⁡n)=ln⁡n⋅ln⁡(1+1n)∼ln⁡nn⟶0,\ln\left(\left(1+\frac1n\right)^{\ln n}\right) =\ln n\cdot\ln\left(1+\frac1n\right) \sim\frac{\ln n}{n}\longrightarrow0 \text,ln((1+n1​)lnn)=lnn⋅ln(1+n1​)∼nlnn​⟶0, tehát (1+1n)ln⁡n⟶1.\boxed{\left(1+\frac1n\right)^{\ln n}\longrightarrow1} \text.(1+n1​)lnn⟶1​.

  6. (n2−n+1n2+n+1)2n+5=(1−2nn2+n+1)2n+5.\left(\frac{n^2-n+1}{n^2+n+1}\right)^{2n+5} =\left(1-\frac{2n}{n^2+n+1}\right)^{2n+5} \text.(n2+n+1n2−n+1​)2n+5=(1−n2+n+12n​)2n+5. Mivel (2n+5)(−2nn2+n+1)⟶−4,(2n+5)\left(-\frac{2n}{n^2+n+1}\right)\longrightarrow-4,(2n+5)(−n2+n+12n​)⟶−4, a határérték e−4.\boxed{e^{-4}} \text.e−4​.

question:
Bizonyítsa be, hogy bármely k≥0k \geq 0k≥0 egész számra
lim⁡n→∞(1+kn)n=ek.\displaystyle \lim_{n \rightarrow \infty} \left( 1 + \frac{k}{n} \right)^n = e^k \text.n→∞lim​(1+nk​)n=ek.
solution:
Az eke^kek határérték teljes indukcióval

Bizonyítsuk, hogy minden k≥0k\geq0k≥0 egészre lim⁡n→∞(1+kn)n=ek.\lim_{n\to\infty}\left(1+\frac{k}{n}\right)^n=e^k \text.n→∞lim​(1+nk​)n=ek. A k=0k=0k=0 eset nyilvánvaló, a k=1k=1k=1 eset pedig az eee szám sorozatos definíciója. Tegyük fel, hogy az állítás valamely kkk-ra igaz. Ekkor (1+k+1n)n=(1+kn+1)n+1(1+1n)nn+1n+k+1⟶ek⋅e⋅1=ek+1.\begin{aligned} \left(1+\frac{k+1}{n}\right)^n &=\left(1+\frac{k}{n+1}\right)^{n+1} \left(1+\frac1n\right)^n \frac{n+1}{n+k+1} \\ &\longrightarrow e^k\cdot e\cdot1=e^{k+1} \text. \end{aligned}(1+nk+1​)n​=(1+n+1k​)n+1(1+n1​)nn+k+1n+1​⟶ek⋅e⋅1=ek+1.​ Az indukciós lépés teljesült, tehát lim⁡n→∞(1+kn)n=ek(k∈N0).\boxed{ \lim_{n\to\infty}\left(1+\frac{k}{n}\right)^n=e^k \quad(k\in\mathbb N_0) } \text.n→∞lim​(1+nk​)n=ek(k∈N0​)​.
